companyInfo.intro: If you are looking for a reliable company in Antalya car rental, Alanya rent a car and airport car rental services, Berg Rent A Car is the right address for you. We make the car rental process fast, safe and comfortable with our corporate service approach, wide vehicle fleet and transparent pricing policy.
companyInfo.introduction: BERG Rent A Car is a brand that serves with its long-standing experience in the car rental industry, strong operational structure and corporate approach. Founded by Ali Dağ, our company set out with the goal of establishing a sustainable structure in the industry; over time, it has consistently developed its service quality, vehicle fleet and organizational strength.
companyInfo.approach: BERG Rent A Car builds its solutions for individual and corporate customers on planned operations, regular vehicle management and a professional service approach. Our goal is to transform the car rental process into a clear and efficient service model free from complexity.
companyInfo.whyContent: Berg Rent A Car offers clear and reliable solutions to its customers with an agent-free and commission-free car rental model. Thanks to our transparent reservation system where you can see all prices in advance without hidden fees, you won't encounter surprises. We produce special solutions for individual and corporate customers with daily, monthly and long-term car rental options.
companyInfo.serviceTitle: Car Rental Service in Antalya & Alanya

You can pick up your vehicle quickly and easily at many points, especially Antalya Airport car rental and Alanya Gazipaşa Airport car rental. faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions and answers
faq.seoDescription: Berg Rent a Car frequently asked questions. Everything you want to know about car rental.
faq.seoKeywords: frequently asked questions, FAQ, car rental questions

items.question: How can I make a reservation?
items.answer: You can easily make a reservation through our website. Start by filling out the search form on the homepage. Select pickup and return dates, locations and find a suitable vehicle. Enter your payment information to complete the reservation process.

items.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your reservations. Cancellation conditions may vary depending on the reservation type. For detailed information, you can check the details page of your reservation or contact our customer service.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept credit card, debit card and cash payment options. Installment payment options are also available. Payment methods will be displayed during the reservation process.

items.question: What are the license requirements?
items.answer: You need a valid driver's license to rent a car. International driver's license is also accepted. The minimum age requirement is usually 21 years, and a higher age limit may apply for some vehicle categories.

items.question: Are vehicles insured?
items.answer: Yes, all our vehicles are covered by basic insurance. Additional insurance options are also available. For detailed information, you can review the insurance options during the reservation or contact our customer service.

items.question: How are vehicle pickup and return procedures done?
items.answer: Vehicle pickup and return are done at your selected location. During vehicle pickup, the vehicle condition is checked and necessary documents are signed. Similarly, a check is made when returning the vehicle. Both processes are completed quickly and easily.

dataSubjectRights.title: 5. Rights of the Data Subject
dataSubjectRights.content1: As a data subject, you have the following rights in accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK:

dataSubjectRights.right3: Learning the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose

dataSubjectRights.right6: Requesting deletion or destruction within the framework of the conditions stipulated in the KVKK
dataSubjectRights.right7: Requesting notification of the correction, deletion, or destruction to third parties to whom personal data has been transferred
dataSubjectRights.right8: Objecting to the occurrence of a result against you by analyzing the processed data exclusively through automated systems
dataSubjectRights.right9: Requesting compensation for damages if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing

whatIsCookie.title: What is a Cookie?
whatIsCookie.content1: Cookies are small text files saved to your device by your browser when you visit websites. These files ensure the website functions properly and improve user experience.
whatIsCookie.content2: As Berg Rent a Car website, we use various cookies to provide our services and improve user experience.

necessary.title: 1. Necessary Cookies
necessary.content1: These are cookies required for the basic functions of our website to work. Our website cannot function properly without these cookies.

performance.title: 2. Performance Cookies
performance.content1: Cookies used to analyze our website's performance and improve user experience.

functionality.title: 3. Functionality Cookies
functionality.content1: Cookies that provide advanced features and personalization of our website.

marketing.title: 4. Marketing Cookies
marketing.content1: Cookies used to show more relevant ads to users and conduct marketing activities. These cookies are only used with your explicit consent.

cookieDurations.title: Cookie Durations
cookieDurations.content1: The cookies we use are of two types: session cookies (deleted when the browser is closed) and persistent cookies (stored on your device for a certain period).
cookieDurations.sessionDesc: Automatically deleted when the browser is closed
cookieDurations.persistentDesc: Stored for periods ranging from 30 days to 2 years

manageCookies.title: Managing Your Cookie Settings
manageCookies.content1: You can manage or delete cookies from your browser settings. However, disabling some cookies may cause some features of our website to not work properly.
manageCookies.item1: Go to the "Cookies" section in your browser's settings menu
manageCookies.item2: Visit the "Cookie Settings" page on our website

kvkPolitikasi.title: Personal Data Protection Policy
kvkPolitikasi.subtitle: In accordance with Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data

generalInfo.title: General Information
generalInfo.content1: As Berg Rent a Car, we take all necessary technical and administrative measures to ensure full compliance with Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK") and related legislation.
generalInfo.content2: The security and privacy of your personal data is our priority. This policy has been prepared to inform you about how your personal data is collected, processed, stored, and protected.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content1: We take the following technical and administrative measures to ensure the security of your personal data:
dataSecurity.item1: Encrypted data transmission with SSL certificate
dataSecurity.item2: Secure server infrastructure and regular security updates
dataSecurity.item4: Regular data backup and recovery procedures
dataSecurity.item6: Regular checks to detect and fix security vulnerabilities

dataRetention.title: Data Retention Periods
dataRetention.content1: Your personal data is stored for the period required by the processing purpose and within the framework of our legal retention obligations:
dataRetention.contactDesc: 10 years after the service relationship ends

dataBreach.title: Data Breach Notification
dataBreach.content1: In case of any breach that may affect the security of your personal data, in accordance with Article 12 of the KVKK:
dataBreach.item1: The breach is reported to the Personal Data Protection Authority within 72 hours at the latest from the time it is detected
dataBreach.item2: If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals, the relevant persons are also notified
dataBreach.item3: Necessary measures are taken and systems are updated to prevent the breach from recurring

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Data Processing
legalBasis.content1: Your personal data is processed for the following legal reasons:
legalBasis.item1: Establishment and performance of service contract
legalBasis.item3: Our legitimate interests (improving service quality, ensuring security)

internationalTransfer.title: International Data Transfer
internationalTransfer.content1: Your personal data may be transferred abroad for the purpose of providing our services. In this case, in accordance with Article 9 of the KVKK:
internationalTransfer.item1: The country to which the transfer will be made must have an adequate level of protection
internationalTransfer.item2: If there is no adequate protection, appropriate safeguards must be provided (contracts, binding corporate rules, etc.)
internationalTransfer.item3: Your explicit consent must be obtained

updates.title: Changes and Updates
updates.content1: This policy may be revised from time to time due to changes in legal regulations, technological developments, or updates to our business processes. We will inform you through our website in case of significant changes.

contact.title: Contact and Application
contact.content1: To exercise your rights under the KVKK or for questions about the policy:
contact.item1: You can send your written application to our address
contact.item2: You can contact us via email
contact.item3: You can file a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Authority
